verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0 and 'available as a hosted service', which implies the service can be self-hosted. It also notes the cloud version has additional features, so a self-hosted deployment would lack some of them. Nothing in the pack mentions Docker images, docker-compose, or production deployment guidance. missing for 10: any documented Docker image or compose setup, self-hosting/production deployment docs, clarity on which features are cloud-only, hands-on corroboration of a containerized production deployment.
